description_zh:
物理 · 化学 · 生物，闯关答题 + 趣味小游戏！

一个科学答题网站，分简单、中等、困难三个模式，覆盖物理、化学、生物三个科目，每科十个单元，每单元三道题（选择题与填空题）。每单元结束后附带一个相关的小游戏。
description_en:
Physics, Chemistry, and Biology — quiz challenges plus fun mini-games!

A science quiz site with Easy, Medium, and Hard modes, covering Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. Each subject has ten units, and each unit contains three questions (multiple choice and fill-in-the-blank), followed by a related mini-game.
